renderingNote: Use image coordinates at native resolution and fit to viewport; if scaled to 1920x1080 use x*1.25, y*(1080/865), width*1.25, height*(1080/865). For libGDX bottom-left coordinates: bottomY=865-topY-height before scaling.
note: The opaque base outside opening acts as frame; do not add a duplicate frame overlay. Door images are fully opaque rectangular sprites. Their off-opening portions must be clipped. Test floor placeholder is not final artwork.
